# State Management Architecture

## Riverpod Generator (`@riverpod`)

All state is driven by Riverpod Generator annotations with compile-time safety.

### Provider Skeleton

```dart
// GENERATED BY: flutter pub run build_runner build
// DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:airbnb_clone/core/state/fsm.dart';

// 1. Idle → Processing → Success/Failure sealed class FSM
final searchStateProvider = _$searchStateProvider;

// 2. Sealed class FSM - zero unhandled UI boundary states
class SearchState implements FSM<SearchState> {
  final SearchStatus status;
  final List<Listing>? listings;
  final SearchError? error;
  final SearchMetadata? metadata;

  const SearchState._({
    required this.status,
    this.listings,
    this.error,
    this.metadata,
  });

  factory SearchState.idle() => const SearchState._(
        status: SearchStatus.idle,
      );

  factory SearchState.loading() => const SearchState._(
        status: SearchStatus.loading,
      );

  factory SearchState.success({
    required List<Listing> listings,
    SearchMetadata? metadata,
  }) => SearchState._(
        status: SearchStatus.success,
        listings: listings,
        metadata: metadata,
      );

  factory SearchState.failure({
    required SearchError error,
  }) => SearchState._(
        status: SearchStatus.failure,
        error: error,
      );

  @override
  SearchStatus get status => status;

  @override
  bool get isIdle => status == SearchStatus.idle;

  @override
  bool get isLoading => status == SearchStatus.loading;

  @override
  bool get isSuccess => status == SearchStatus.success;

  @override
  bool get isFailure => status == SearchStatus.failure;
}

// 3. Sealed class hierarchies
enum SearchStatus { idle, loading, success, failure }

class SearchError implements Error {
  final String code;
  final String message;
  final int statusCode;

  const SearchError({
    required this.code,
    required this.message,
    this.statusCode = 0,
  });

  @override
  String toString() => 'SearchError(code: $code, message: $message)';
}

class SearchMetadata {
  final int page;
  final int total;
  final bool hasMore;

  const SearchMetadata({
    required this.page,
    required this.total,
    this.hasMore = false,
  });
}

// 4. Provider composition - deterministic FSM consumption
final listingsProvider = StateProvider.autoDispose((ref) => <Listing>[]);

final searchProvider = StateNotifierProvider<SearchNotifier, SearchState>(
  (ref) => SearchNotifier(
    listingRepository: ref.read(listingRepositoryProvider),
    searchRepository: ref.read(searchRepositoryProvider),
  ),
);

// 5. UI consumption - purely declarative
// ❌ WRONG: useState()/setState() - impure, untestable
// ✅ RIGHT: Watch provider, react to state changes only

Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(searchProvider);
  
  // Compiler forces handling ALL states
  return state.when(
    idle: () => const SearchBar(),
    loading: () => const ShimmerLoading(),
    success: (listings) => ListingsGrid(listings: listings),
    failure: (error) => ErrorRetry(
      onRetry: ref.read(searchProvider.notifier).state,
    ),
  );
}
```

### State Notifier Pattern

```dart
class SearchNotifier extends StateNotifier<SearchState> {
  final ListingRepository _listingRepo;
  final SearchRepository _searchRepo;

  SearchNotifier({
    required ListingRepository listingRepository,
    required SearchRepository searchRepository,
  }) : _listingRepo = listingRepository,
       _searchRepo = searchRepository,
       super(const SearchState.idle());

  Future<void> fetchSearch({
    required String query,
    required DateRange dateRange,
    required int guestCount,
  }) async {
    state = const SearchState.loading();

    final result = await _searchRepo.execute(
      query: query,
      dateRange: dateRange,
      guestCount: guestCount,
    );

    result.fold(
      (failure) => state = SearchState.failure(error: failure),
      (success) => state = SearchState.success(
        listings: success.listings,
        metadata: success.metadata,
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### Key Rules

| Rule | Rationale |
|------|-----------|
| **ALL UI** consumes state via `ref.watch(provider).when(...)` | Compiler forces exhaustive state handling |
| **NO** `setState()`, `StatefulWidget.buildState()`, local `bool loading` | Impure, breaks determinism, untestable |
| **Providers** modeled as `StateNotifierProvider` with FSM sealed classes | Predictable transitions, single source of truth |
| **Sealed classes** implement `FSM` interface (`status`, `isIdle`, `isLoading`, etc.) | Guarantees UI covers all boundaries |
| **State** is `final` - never mutate directly | Reactive updates only via notifier |
| **@riverpod generator** - never manual `Provider.autoDispose` | Compile-time safety, ref type-safety |
